name: Conformance: v2 ctx.mcp client
description: RFC 0204 fixture for `v2-mcp-client-results.test.ts`. One node, `core.conformance.mcp-client` (conformance-RESERVED, like `core.conformance.mcp-invoke`): a host that advertises `mcp.client` maps it to a node that calls its own `ctx.mcp.<method>` with the run's inputs (`method` ∈ callTool | listTools | readResource | serverHealth; `serverId`; `name`, `arguments` for callTool; `cursor` for listTools; `uri` for readResource) and completes with `outputs.result` equal to the resolved value VERBATIM, recorded on its `node.completed` event. A rejection fails the node with the rejection's code (`not_found` for an unknown `serverId`). Operator contract: the host binds `serverId: "conformance"` to the suite's fake MCP server and `"conformance-down"` to an address nothing answers. A host that does not advertise `mcp.client` MUST NOT advertise this fixture.
